name: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.
moat_justification: Moderate-strong at franchise level, diluted at company level: GTA is a durable owned franchise with proven pricing power ($79.99, unprecedented pre-orders) and NBA 2K is entrenched with recurrent spending at 84% of Q1 FY27 bookings, but roughly half the company is Zynga mobile (bought traffic, low switching costs, goodwill impairments of $2,342M in FY2024 and $3,545M in FY2025), NBA 2K is licensed not owned, there is no owned platform, and one title drives the FY2027 step-up after two delays.
fragility_flags: DILUTION: share count growing 4.8%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: Elite franchise portfolio, moat 6/10, priced entirely on a launch that hasn't filed yet — owner's earnings are negative on normalized (-$2.90/share) and TTM (-$0.07/share) bases with only 1 positive year in 5, so it cannot clear the 15% hurdle at $200.32 on an OE DCF today; even capitalising that single positive year gives IV@15% of just $10.40.
moat_for: GTA: durable owned franchise, 13-year tail on prior entry, premium $79.99 pricing with unprecedented pre-orders
NBA 2K: entrenched annual franchise, habitual recurrent spending
Recurrent consumer spending 84% of Q1 FY27 net bookings — live-services base
Rockstar development capability rivals cannot simply buy
moat_against: Concentration: one title drives FY2027; mainline GTA gaps run over a decade and GTA VI already slipped twice
Zynga mobile ~half the company: low switching costs, bought traffic, mobile bookings -7% in Q1 FY27, $2,342M + $3,545M goodwill impairments FY24/25
NBA 2K is licensed, not owned — league cut and renewal risk
No owned platform: Sony/Microsoft storefront economics sit between TTWO and console players
AAA cost inflation raises capital at risk per release; capitalised development costs excluded from engine capex make OE generous, not harsh
